label: smollm-135m
method: GPU only. One untimed warm-up window, then the timed full WikiText-2 test split pass in 1,024-token windows, wall clock. Baseline is the previous code path in the same binary (flags --old-gemm --old-attention).
parity_statement: Baseline is the previous code path (64 x 64 matmul, one-workgroup-per-query attention, f32 weights) in the same binary. Tolerance for the f32 paths: cross-entropy within 1e-4 nats of the baseline on the same slice (the NLL_TOL of the parity tests); observed at most 4.1e-8 nats. f16, Q8_0 and Q4_0 report their own difference instead of a tolerance: f16 is lossless here because these checkpoints are stored in bf16 or fp16 (every weight is exactly representable); Q8_0 and Q4_0 change the model and the difference is the quality cost.
